Good food but service could be improved
Feb 2020 • Couples
I saw lots of good reviews about this place, and in all of them the food looked very good. After eating there a couple of times, i have to say it really did taste good. Very good seasoning and the portions were okay.
HOWEVER, i had a problem each time with the service. My first time there was during Tet, and they didnt seem very enthusiastic to go to work. After writing down our order, they just turned and walked away. I get it, it's the holiday. So i still came back for the second time. 
Second time i was with a German friend. Realized they spoke very little English there. Tried to convince me to take the fried fish, although my friend was allergic to fish. When we said we couldnt take the fish, they just turned and walked away again??!?
Third time, we went there a bit late, around 2.30pm. I was careful and had to google if they had an afternoon break. They didnt. Went there, concierge invited us up. Got assigned a seat and were brought menus. Then the waiter came and told us THEY WERE TAKING A BREAK AND WERE NOT SERVING??!? Afterwards, again, he trotted away to the kitchen and spied secretly on us to see if we could take the cue and leave.
All of the staff was there the entire time, one opened the door for us. No sorrys, no 'maybe you could visit us some other time'. Nothing. 
Although i really liked the food there, there's enough Thai restaurants in Saigon with better service that wont challenge me.

Highly recommend and I'm sure will come back very soon.
